units.source_text: 我首先想到的是，老师是否突然得了什么急病，忍耐着病痛的发作。

en.t: The first thing that occurred to me was that perhaps the teacher had suddenly fallen ill with some acute sickness and was enduring an attack of pain.

units.source_text: 如果我立即走过去照拂就好了。

en.t: I should have gone over to look after him at once.
